sender.zh: 陌生号码（自称“电力公司”）

message.en: URGENT: your electricity bill is 2 months late. Power will be cut off in 1 hour. To keep it on, pay $450 now by Interac e-Transfer or Zelle to billing.demo@example.invalid, or buy gift cards and read us the numbers. Reply PAID when done.
message.zh: 【紧急】您的电费已拖欠2个月。1小时后将停电。要保住供电，请马上用 Interac 电子转账或 Zelle 支付450加元，收款邮箱 billing.demo@example.invalid；或者购买礼品卡并把卡号念给我们。付款后回复“已付”。

en.t: Power will be cut off in 1 hour
pay $450 now by Interac e-Transfer or Zelle
buy gift cards and read us the numbers

zh.t: 马上用 Interac 电子转账或 Zelle 支付450加元
购买礼品卡并把卡号念给我们

hints.en: Look at the ways they ask you to pay. Would a real electric company ask for gift card numbers?
hints.zh: 请看他们要您用什么方式付款。真正的电力公司会要礼品卡的卡号吗？

hints.en: Now look at “1 hour”. Why would they want you to rush?
hints.zh: 再看“1小时”。他们为什么要您这么匆忙？

explanation.en: Real utility companies send a bill, give you time, and accept normal payment methods. They never ask for gift cards, or for an e-transfer or Zelle payment to a stranger's e-mail address. A gift card number is the same as cash: once you read it out, the money is gone. Check your bill, or call the number printed on it.
explanation.zh: 真正的公用事业公司会寄账单、给您时间，并接受正常的付款方式。他们不会要礼品卡，也不会让您向陌生邮箱电子转账或用 Zelle 付款。礼品卡卡号等于现金，一念出来钱就没了。请查看账单，或拨打账单上印的电话。

sender.en: Text from an unknown number (“Postal Service”)
sender.zh: 陌生号码短信（自称“邮政”）

message.en: [Postal Service] Your parcel could not be delivered: the address is incomplete. Update it and pay a $1.99 redelivery fee within 24 hours, or it will be returned: https://post-redeliver.example
message.zh: 【邮政】您的包裹因地址不完整无法派送。请在24小时内更新地址并支付1.99加元重新派送费，否则将被退回：https://post-redeliver.example

hints.en: Are you waiting for a package? Does the message say who sent it or what is inside?
hints.zh: 您在等包裹吗？这条消息有说是谁寄的、里面是什么吗？

hints.en: Look at the end of the message. Where do they want you to go to pay?
hints.zh: 请看消息的最后。他们要您去哪里付款？

explanation.en: A tiny fee is the bait. Once you open the link and type in your card, scammers can take much more. Real carriers leave a notice at your door or let you track the parcel in their official app. Do not tap the link. Open the carrier's own app or website yourself.
explanation.zh: 收一点小钱是诱饵。您一点开链接、输入银行卡，骗子就能拿走更多。真正的快递公司会在门口留通知，或者让您在官方App里查包裹。不要点链接，自己打开快递公司的官方App或网站。

sender.en: Stranger who added you to a WeChat group
sender.zh: 陌生人把您拉进了微信群

message.en: Welcome to the Stock Winners VIP group! Our teacher Anna shows you how to earn 5% every week, guaranteed, with our special trading app. Only 20 places this month. Download the app (link below), then transfer $5,000 to start. Members already withdrew big profits!
message.zh: 欢迎加入“股市赢家”VIP群！安娜老师带您使用专属交易App，每周稳赚5%，保证收益。本月仅限20个名额。请下载App（链接见下方），先转入5000加元开始。群友们已经提现大笔利润啦！

hints.en: Look at the promise: a fixed profit every week, guaranteed. Can any honest investment guarantee that?
hints.zh: 请看他们的承诺：每周固定收益，还保证。有哪种正规投资敢这样保证？

hints.en: Think about how you got here. Did you ask to join this group, or did a stranger add you?
hints.zh: 想一想您是怎么进来的。是您自己要加入，还是陌生人把您拉进来的？

explanation.en: No honest investment can guarantee a profit every week. Scammers add strangers to groups where fake members cheer about big profits, and a fake app shows fake gains until you try to withdraw. Real investments go through a licensed adviser or your own bank, and you can check them yourself.
explanation.zh: 没有哪个正规投资能保证每周赚钱。骗子把陌生人拉进群，里面的假群友不停地晒收益，假App也会显示虚假盈利，直到您想提现。正规投资要通过有牌照的理财顾问或您自己的银行，您也可以自己去核实。

message.en: ⚠ WARNING: Your computer is infected with 7 viruses! Your photos and bank logins are at risk. Do NOT turn off your computer. Call Tech Support now at 1-888-555-0147 for free repair. Our technician will connect to your computer.
message.zh: ⚠ 警告：您的电脑感染了7种病毒！您的照片和银行账号有危险。请勿关机。请立即拨打技术支持电话 1-888-555-0147，免费修复。我们的技术员将远程连接您的电脑。

en.t: Do NOT turn off your computer

hints.en: Look at the big scary words. Why would a message on a website want you to feel afraid?
hints.zh: 请看那些吓人的大字。网页上的消息为什么想让您害怕？

hints.en: Now look at the last sentence. What could the technician do if you let them connect to your computer?
hints.zh: 再看最后一句。如果您让技术员连上您的电脑，他能做什么？

explanation.en: Real security software never puts a phone number in a pop-up, and companies like Microsoft or Apple do not warn you this way. If a stranger controls your computer, they can see your bank logins. Close the browser, or turn the computer off. If you worry, ask your family or a local shop you trust.
explanation.zh: 真正的安全软件不会在弹窗里留电话，微软、苹果这样的公司也不会这样警告您。让陌生人控制您的电脑，他们就能看到您的银行账号。请关掉浏览器，或直接关机。如果担心，问问家人或您信得过的本地电脑店。
